results.headline: HALF YEARLY RESULTS FOR THE PERIOD ENDED 30 SEP 26
results.key_quote: Operating profit was £13.9m, up £2.8m compared with £11.1m profit for the same period last year. Earnings per ordinary share were 57.3p compared with 47.9p for the same period last year.
results.summary: James Latham reported H1 FY2027 results with revenue up 11.4% to £219.3m and operating profit up 20.1% to £13.9m versus the prior year comparable period. Gross profit margin expanded to 16.8% from 16.2%. EPS increased 19.6% to 57.3p. The company increased its interim dividend from 8.10p to 8.45p. While the company does not explicitly state performance versus analyst expectations, the operational improvements (particularly margin expansion despite input cost pressures), volume growth of 5.4%, and dividend increase suggest performance ahead of what might be reasonably expected given the economic headwinds noted. The company acknowledges challenges ahead but maintains a positive stance.

results.headline: Wild Mustang Drilling and Pipeline Update
results.key_quote: The gas indications in these additional intervals are encouraging.
results.summary: Upland Resources provides an operational update on the Wild Mustang gas development in Wyoming. GMF-5 well drilling is progressing toward target formations with unexpected gas shows in two non-targeted intervals (Fort Union and Upper Sussex formations); the Upper Sussex shows averaged over 750 total gas units. The gas sales pipeline is approximately 80% complete with connection to existing infrastructure expected in December 2026. No comparison to market expectations, guidance, or forecasts is made in this announcement. This is a purely operational progress update with no statement of performance versus expectations.

results.headline: November Trading Update
results.key_quote: we now expect to exceed the upper end of our full-year guidance. This reflects improved field performance, in particular high value Jubilee production, and includes contributions from new wells, continued optimisation and a relentless focus on delivery across the business.
results.summary: Tullow Oil has delivered significantly ahead of expectations in 2026. Production performance is materially stronger than guided, with the company now expecting to exceed the upper end of its full-year production guidance range of 34-42 kboepd. Jubilee oil production and TEN oil production both performed above expectations. All six Jubilee producers and one water injector from the 2025-26 well campaign met or exceeded pre-drill expectations. The company has resolved Ghana tax assessments, providing greater certainty for continued investment. Free cash flow guidance was narrowed to $160-210 million (from $170-250 million) due to the $112 million tax settlement payment, though this is offset by strong production performance with two October cargoes realizing above $100/bbl.
metrics_ahead: Full-year production expected to exceed upper end of guidance range
Wells in line with or exceeding pre-drill expectations

results.headline: Trading Update, Results Notice & IR Presentation
results.key_quote: FY27 has started well, with each of the acquired businesses trading ahead of expectations and the same period last year, before Roadside's ownership. On a weekly run-rate basis, FY27 has started ahead of management expectations and prior year.
results.summary: Roadside Real Estate reports that in FY27 each acquired business is trading ahead of expectations and prior year. The Coventry site reopened in September 2026 and is already the second highest weekly fuel volume forecourt and significantly ahead of industry averages. Adjusted EBITDA for FY26 is stated to be in line with market expectations. Management explicitly states FY27 has started ahead of management expectations on a weekly run-rate basis. While FY26 Adjusted EBITDA is in line with expectations, the forward-looking FY27 commentary clearly indicates performance ahead of expectations.
metrics_ahead: Each acquired business trading ahead of expectations
Coventry site significantly ahead of industry averages
Weekly run-rate basis ahead of management expectations

results.headline: Monthly Performance Update
results.key_quote: PIN announced an unaudited net asset value (NAV) per share of 539.8p as at 31 October 2026, a decrease of -6.5p (-1.2%) from the NAV per share as at 30 September 2026.
results.summary: Pantheon International reported its October 2026 monthly performance update showing a NAV per share of 539.8p, down 1.2% month-on-month. The document is a factual performance update providing portfolio metrics, cash flows, and buyback activity. No forward guidance, expectations, or comparisons to analyst/board forecasts are provided. The report contains no statements indicating performance is ahead of, in line with, or below any stated expectations.

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: The Group has continued its recovery following the economic and market difficulties of the last five years. Profit before tax reduced from the comparable period last year but this was due to relatively small one-off items. On an underlying basis, our profit was steady.
results.summary: First Property Group reported interim results for H1 2026 with statutory profit before tax of £1.01m (down 31.8% YoY) but underlying profit of £1.11m (up 3.7% YoY). The decline in statutory profit was attributed to one-off items. The company notes stabilization following prior difficulties, with cautious outlook on UK market conditions but optimism on Polish market. No explicit comparison to expectations or guidance provided in the announcement.

results.headline: MMI update, valuation & funding
results.key_quote: progress in a number of areas has been slower than originally anticipated; revenues remain below earlier expectations; valuation reduction of 28.5 per cent from current holding value
results.summary: Crystal Amber Fund's investment in Morphic Medical Inc. has underperformed expectations. Patient recruitment is behind schedule, commercial revenues remain below earlier expectations due to reimbursement delays, and the investment has been written down 28.5% from $116.8m to $83.5m. While manufacturing progress is noted as 'materially reducing' supply-chain risks, the overall narrative emphasizes execution risks, funding challenges, and a 'cautious approach to valuation' by the Investment Adviser.
metrics_ahead: Manufacturing and supply-chain risk reduction noted

results.headline: Fourth Quarter Trading Update
results.key_quote: Projected Adjusted Diluted EPRA EPS for FY 2026 expected to be in line with analyst forecasts
results.summary: Safestore delivered resilient Q4 performance with total group revenue growth of 2.9% YTD at constant currency, supported by new store contributions of £5.2m for the year. However, the company explicitly states that Adjusted Diluted EPRA EPS for FY 2026 is expected to be 'in line with analyst forecasts', indicating performance meets rather than exceeds expectations. Like-for-like revenue was modest at 0.7% growth in Q4, with UK stabilizing and Paris recovering, while expansion markets showed strong 12.0% growth. No guidance upgrade was provided.
metrics_ahead: Total Group revenue growth 4.5% YTD at CER
Expansion Markets revenue up 12.0% in Q4
New store contributions of £5.2m to FY 2026 revenue
MLA growth of 4.4% to 9.69m sq ft
UK like-for-like revenue up 0.5% in Q4

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Based on the continued positive trading performance, and not including the contribution from Southwest Galvanizing, the acquisition made last week, we now expect full year 2026 operating profit to be modestly above current analyst expectations.
results.summary: Hill & Smith reports trading slightly ahead of expectations in the four-month period to 31 October 2026, with strong revenue acceleration. The company has raised full year 2026 operating profit guidance to be modestly above current analyst expectations (consensus $216.7m). Revenue growth accelerated to 12% organic constant currency in the period versus 5% in H1, driven by strong US infrastructure demand. Operating margins are expected to progress in H2. While some segments faced headwinds (UK subdued demand, Galvanizing margins slightly below prior year), the overall trajectory is ahead of expectations with guidance upgrade.
metrics_ahead: full year operating profit raised to modestly above analyst expectations
revenue growth accelerated to 12% OCC in period
group operating margin ahead of first half
US Engineered Solutions performed very strongly with growth above first half level
operating margin ahead of prior year period

results.headline: Half-year results for six months to 30/09/26
results.key_quote: Foresight delivered further profitable growth in the first half of FY27, building on the progress achieved last year...are well positioned for another strong year of retail fundraising.
results.summary: Foresight reported H1 FY27 results with revenue up 10% to £84.6m and core EBITDA pre-SBP up 7% to £34.0m. Recurring revenue increased 9% to £72m, maintaining the target range of 85-90%. Dividend increased 11% to 9.0p per share. While the company showed year-on-year growth, the results appear to track management expectations rather than exceed them. The commentary indicates the company is 'on track' and 'well positioned' for continued performance, consistent with guidance maintenance. No explicit statement of beating analyst or market expectations was provided.

results.headline: FY27 Guidance Update
results.key_quote: We are pleased to upgrade our FY27 revenue and Cash EBITDA guidance. The improved outlook reflects the continued benefits of disciplined cost management across the business together with increased certainty in our project services revenue outlook.
results.summary: Bravura has upgraded both FY27 Revenue guidance (from $280m-$300m to $285m-$305m) and Cash EBITDA guidance (from $84m-$94m to $93m-$103m), representing material upward revisions. The company is performing materially ahead of its previous expectations due to strong project services demand, disciplined cost management, and favorable foreign exchange movements. This is a clear guidance upgrade reflecting stronger than previously anticipated performance.
metrics_ahead: Revenue guidance upgraded to higher range

results.headline: Arrow Announces Q3 2026 Interim Results
results.key_quote: Q3 2026 was a record quarter for Arrow, with average production of 5,294 boe/d, our highest to date, and a 75% increase in revenue year on year.
results.summary: Arrow reported record Q3 2026 results materially ahead of prior year performance. Revenue increased 75% year-on-year to $32.5 million, production rose 26% to 5,294 boe/d (described as highest to date), Adjusted EBITDA increased 67% to $18 million, and operating netbacks improved significantly to $47.79/boe from $35.72/boe. The company achieved these results while maintaining a strong balance sheet with $28.7 million cash and no debt. CEO commentary explicitly characterizes Q3 2026 as a 'record quarter' tied to exceptional operational and financial performance.
metrics_ahead: production 5,294 boe/d described as highest to date
operating cash flows up 72% to $19.1 million

results.headline: Half-Yearly Results
results.key_quote: The Board is pleased with AEWU's performance in the first half of the year. The Company has delivered a shareholder total return of 8.08% and a NAV total return of 2.8% against a subdued commercial property market.
results.summary: AEW UK REIT delivered mixed financial performance with some metrics improving and others declining versus the prior year comparative period. NAV total return of 2.84% was slightly ahead of prior year (2.70%), and EPS improved to 3.07pps from 2.98pps. However, EPRA EPS declined from 3.91pps to 3.67pps, and operating profit before fair value changes fell from £6.96m to £6.33m. Shareholder total return of 8.08% was below prior year (11.44%). The company maintained its dividend of 2pps per share for 44 consecutive quarters and achieved a strong 40%+ rental uplift on two industrial assets. No explicit comparison to market or analyst expectations was stated, but the board expressed satisfaction with performance in a 'subdued commercial property market,' suggesting results were acceptable relative to market conditions.
metrics_ahead: NAV total return slightly improved year-on-year
Strong rental uplifts secured (40%+ on two assets)
Shares trading close to NAV (1.5% average discount versus 33% peer group average discount)

results.headline: Interim Results for the Six Months ended 30 Sep 26
results.key_quote: Strong operating performance underpinning an 11.3% annualised gross portfolio return, ahead of the 8.5% opening weighted average discount rate.
results.summary: HICL delivered first-half results ahead of expectations with a gross portfolio return of 11.3% annualised, comfortably exceeding the 8.5% opening weighted average discount rate. NAV per share increased to 160.5p despite a 20bps increase in WADR. The company remains on track to deliver its dividend targets for FY27 and FY28, and has made early progress on its refreshed strategy targeting total returns above 10% per annum. Key metrics include 7% year-on-year EBITDA growth in growth assets and 99% PPP availability.
metrics_ahead: 11.3% annualised gross portfolio return ahead of 8.5% opening WADR
7% year-on-year EBITDA growth in growth assets

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Group adjusted profit before tax for FY 2026 is now expected to be ahead of recently upgraded expectations and at least £7.3m (26 August 2026 Interim Results: at least £6.2m)
results.summary: Empresaria has upgraded its full-year 2026 profit expectations, with adjusted profit before tax now expected to be ahead of recently upgraded expectations at a minimum of £7.3m, up from the £6.2m guidance provided at interim results on 26 August 2026. This represents a material upgrade driven by continued focus on financial performance through cost discipline and improved management oversight.
metrics_ahead: Adjusted profit before tax upgraded to at least £7.3m vs prior guidance of £6.2m

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Given these delays, the Board now expects FY26 revenue to be a minimum of $60m, with adjusted loss before tax of no more than $4m. FY26 consensus market expectations at the date of this announcement are revenue of $73m and break-even adjusted profit before tax.
results.summary: Nexteq has significantly missed consensus expectations on FY26 revenue and profitability. The company expected revenue of $60m versus consensus expectations of $73m (18% shortfall), and an adjusted loss of up to $4m versus break-even expectations. Key order delays from Gaming customers have been pushed into FY27, and new Densitron customer orders have been delayed from FY26 into Q1 2027. The company attributes this to challenging land-based Gaming market conditions driven by tariffs and component costs extending lead times. While Densitron performs well with higher order book and Launchpad shows early progress, the overall FY26 outturn falls materially short of market expectations.

results.headline: Full Year Results
results.key_quote: Resilient trading ahead of the market with like-for-like sales growth of 2.1%
results.summary: Mitchells & Butlers delivered resilient full-year performance ahead of market expectations. Like-for-like sales growth of 2.1% outperformed the market as measured by NIQ Hospitality Market Monitor. Adjusted operating profit increased to £332m despite £120m cost headwinds, with the company continuing to gain market share. The CEO emphasized outperformance of the market and strength of the portfolio, positioning the company ahead of sector expectations.
metrics_ahead: Like-for-like sales growth of 2.1% ahead of the market
Adjusted operating profit increased to £332m despite cost headwinds
Continued outperformance vs market over 8-week period

results.headline: Annual General Meeting Results
results.key_quote: The Board acknowledges the outcome of the vote and will continue its engagement with shareholders to understand the matters underlying the vote and to consider shareholder feedback in relation to the Company's remuneration framework and disclosures.
results.summary: This announcement reports AGM voting results only. No financial performance metrics, earnings, revenue, or operational results are disclosed. No comparison to expectations, guidance, or forecasts is provided. The announcement addresses shareholder voting outcomes on remuneration matters, with Resolution 1 receiving a 'first strike' (at least 25% votes against) and Resolution 6B failing to pass. This is a corporate governance disclosure with no performance guidance element.

results.headline: Interim Results
results.key_quote: Record first half demonstrates strength of CMC's diversified B2B model PBT up 115% despite historically subdued volatility
results.summary: CMC Markets delivered record net operating income of £286.6m (up 54% YoY), surpassing the previous first-half record of £230.9m from HY2021. PBT increased 115% to £106.0m with margin expansion of 10.5ppts to 37.0%. These exceptional results were achieved against historically subdued market volatility, demonstrating the strength of the diversified B2B model and operational leverage. Guidance was reiterated as upgraded. The company achieved record results across multiple metrics including EBITDA (up 104%), EPS (up 118%), and interim dividend (up 84%).
metrics_ahead: Record net operating income of £286.6m surpassing previous first-half record
Strong performance despite subdued volatility demonstrating business diversification
Australian stockbroking achieved another record first half

results.headline: Trading Update
results.key_quote: Trading for H1 27 was in line with management expectations, with significant progress against a challenging macroeconomic backdrop.
results.summary: ProService reported H1 27 revenues of c. £145 million and underlying EBITDA of £2.3 million, explicitly stated as in line with management expectations. The company has delivered positive underlying EBITDA since May and expects strong H2 FY27 supported by seasonal revenues. The company narrowed its FY27 underlying EBITDA guidance range to between £9.0 million and £10.5 million and remains on track to meet market expectations (consensus: £298.5m revenue, £9.5m EBITDA). While operational progress on Project Sync and revenue growth at SCS are noted as progressing in line with expectations, there is no indication that results materially exceeded forecasts.

results.headline: Final results for the year ended 30 June 2026
results.key_quote: The loss before tax fell significantly to £1,394,000 (2025: £6,344,000), driven by unrealised investment gains of £2,602,000
results.summary: Frontier IP Group reported final results for the year ended 30 June 2026 with no explicit comparison to market or analyst expectations. The company showed improved financial performance with unrealised investment gains of £2.6m (vs prior year loss of £3.0m), equity portfolio fair value increased 11% to £37.1m, and loss before tax fell significantly to £1.4m from £6.3m. Operating expenses excluding depreciation decreased 11%. The company raised £5.4m in gross proceeds and announced a cost reduction programme expected to save £1m annually. Portfolio companies achieved significant milestones including European Commission approval of €211m Italian State Aid for 2D Photonics subsidiary and positive vaccine results from The Vaccine Group. However, no specific guidance or expectation comparisons were stated in the announcement.

results.headline: Update on Val Vedello Exploration Permit Appl...
results.key_quote: The request for supplementary information from MASE constitutes an ordinary procedural step within the EIA process
results.summary: Reveille announced that its Italian subsidiary received a request for supplementary information from the Italian Ministry regarding the Environmental Impact Assessment for the Val Vedello uranium exploration permit application. This is described as an ordinary procedural step in the EIA process. The company is proceeding to collect the necessary data and prepare supplementary documentation. No financial results, operational metrics, or performance comparisons to expectations are provided in this announcement - it is a project development update only.

results.headline: Half Yearly Results
results.key_quote: Results are in line with the trading update issued on 19 November 2026.
results.summary: Iomart reported H1 FY27 results explicitly stated as 'in line with' the trading update of 19 November 2026. Revenue declined 11% to £69.0m and Adjusted EBITDA fell to £9.0m from £12.9m in H1'26, reflecting customer churn and reduced non-recurring revenue. However, management provided positive commentary on operational improvements: churn is reducing, net order bookings returned to positive in September, two significant new customers were won (£2.75m ARR), and Q2 EBITDA improved sequentially to £5.3m. The board maintains its expectation that performance will be weighted towards H2, supported by these operational improvements. While results show year-on-year decline, they align with previously provided guidance rather than beating or missing expectations.

results.headline: Trading update
results.key_quote: The Board anticipates the Group's performance for the year ending 31 December 2026 will be in line with full year expectations
results.summary: Macfarlane Group reports performance in line with full year market expectations (revenue £308.3m and adjusted operating profit £20.9m). Revenue in the first 10 months is 4% ahead of prior year with growth in both divisions, and profit is ahead of the same period in 2025. The company maintains stable gross margins and cost control. The language explicitly states performance is 'in line with' and 'in line to meet' market expectations, which is a clear IN_LINE classification rather than ahead.
metrics_ahead: 10-month revenue ahead of prior year by 4%

results.headline: Update on Operations in Namibia
results.key_quote: We have maintained a fast pace of progress with our Namibian fieldwork in order to commence our drilling programme as soon as our partner, Capital Drilling, has completed mobilisation at site.
results.summary: Serval Resources provided an operational update on its Namibian exploration programme ahead of a planned drilling campaign. The company announced mobilisation of two diamond core drill rigs for a 20,000 metre drilling programme, with IP surveys underway at top prospects identifying high-priority copper-silver targets with chargeability and resistivity anomalies in areas of confirmed mineralisation, plus new targets. The company also repaid £1 million of deferred consideration to reduce debt. No explicit comparison to market expectations, board expectations, or analyst forecasts was provided in this operational update.

results.headline: Halfords Group PLC: Interim results for the 2...
results.key_quote: Further upgrade to guidance with strong results across the business...we now expect FY27 underlying PBT to be between £60m and £65m
results.summary: Halfords delivered strong interim results significantly ahead of expectations with underlying PBT up 66% to £39.0m, gross margin expansion of 120bps to 52.6%, and all key financial metrics materially improved. Management has upgraded full-year FY27 guidance to the upper end of their previously communicated range (£60m-£65m underlying PBT), demonstrating confidence in underlying momentum. The company capitalised on favourable summer weather (~£8m profit boost) and has strong strategic progress with the 'Optimise' phase delivering tangible improvements. Free cash flow of £38.0m and net cash of £40.1m (up 115.6%) further demonstrate strong execution.
metrics_ahead: Free cash flow £38.0m vs £32.4m prior year
